purpose: Specification of the context-gathering tasks used by forge create skills: document search by the orchestrator and existing-code exploration by a general-purpose agent.
summary: Overview of two collection kinds and the rule that no agent sits between the orchestrator and document search
No session directories or intermediate files; results stay in main context
Failure handling: stop and report to the user when search fails or an agent errors
Task list: spec research, implementation rule research, existing code research with executors, outputs and search means
Agent bullet list line format with path and one-line reason
Per-skill application matrix is delegated to the orchestrator design document
start-implement launches no collection agent and is out of scope
Agent instruction via a three-element prompt template: purpose, means, output contract
Agents are self-contained and receive no session directory or external spec paths
tasks: Designing or changing context-gathering tasks in create skills
Writing prompt templates for existing-code collection agents
Deciding the output format of collection agents
Checking which skills use collection agents
title: DES-013 コンテキスト収集タスク仕様
